scientific_hypothesis: A full-SMILES source-conditioned student can learn the boundary between verified strict edits and close valid failures more directly from same-prompt preferences than from positive-only SFT.

pair_contract.positive: official Table1 strict success at 0.65 source similarity and nonidentity
pair_contract.negative: same train source/program, valid, official strict failure, closest source Tanimoto then property fraction
pair_contract.leakage: fail closed over eval identifiers, sources, original targets, positive pseudo-targets, and negative pseudo-targets

rounds.R2: same data, base, beta, optimizer, training and decoding; only pair loss weighting changes to teacher confidence

evaluation: seed7 P6 hard de novo and MolEdit Table1; raw k=1,8,20, candidate validity and identity; no rerank
